basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: Cloud AI Engineer · 9,300★ Open-Source Contributor · Terraform · Kubernetes · Agentic AI (MCP, LLMs) · 3.5+ Years

summaries.teradata-cloud-ai: Cloud AI Engineer with 3.5+ years building scalable, distributed cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP — hands-on with Terraform/HCL, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and Kafka event-driven pipelines — and integrating agentic AI (Model Context Protocol, multi-agent LLM workflows) into production systems using Claude Code as a default engineering workflow. Built the Steampipe MCP server and an LLM-driven Claude Code automation that migrated 35+ Azure modules to event-driven architecture, cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90% — one of 120+ merged pull requests across Turbot's 9,300★ open-source suite.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, giving LLM agents standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud and security data for retrieval and analysis.

Designed a multi-agent workflow on the OpenAI Agents SDK to orchestrate LLM agents that generate cloud preventive-policy commands, validate them in a live test environment, self-correct failures, and score accounts against an internal security metric — applying agentic AI directly to production infrastructure.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, Terraform-driven integration testing, and PR creation; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules from polling to an event-driven architecture via Azure Event Grid, cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90% and eliminating recurring Azure API throttling.

Built a Kafka-based, fire-and-forget event-driven pipeline for Turbot Guardrails, where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook once a policy was successfully enforced against a resource; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to capture recurring failures for manual investigation and debugging.

Designed and developed an internal RESTful API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a Preventive Security Posture Management (PSPM) SaaS product; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 (Auth0), containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices; all changes shipped through peer code review via GitHub pull requests.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering customer compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements and multi-stage CTEs — resolving a production performance bottleneck: 40% faster queries (cutting report generation from 3 minutes to 1.5 minutes across 10,000+ resources) and eliminating a class of false-positive findings.
